description: This PHP class defines a database migration for version 5.8.0 of the OrangeHRM system, handling schema updates, foreign key corrections, and language string updates.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for updating schema and language strings in OrangeHRM version 5.8.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes the migration steps, including schema introspection, foreign key correction, and language string updates.

methods.name: correctingCurrencyIdColumnInconsistencies
methods.description: Fixes foreign key constraints and column definitions related to currency_id fields.

methods.name: getConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign keys that conflict with the expected schema for a given table.

methods.name: removeConflictingForeignKeys
methods.description: Drops foreign keys that are conflicting.

methods.name: recreateRemovedForeignKeys
methods.description: Recreates foreign keys that were previously dropped.

methods.name: getNativeConnection
methods.description: Returns the native PDO connection object.

methods.name: disableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Disables foreign key checks in the database.

methods.name: enableForeignKeyChecks
methods.description: Enables foreign key checks in the database.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a LangStringHelper instance.

methods.name: updateLangStringVersion
methods.description: Updates the language string version in the database.
